lines.text: times and even five times. Hazrat Usman  rejected all these offers. Hazrat
Umar  got up angrily and said, “Usman , why have you become so
hard hearted now, whereas you used to be generous in the days of Hazrat
Muhammad (J" . He answered, "I am only doing business and
I would sell my goods to the one who would give me the greatest profit." The
Caliph raised his offer higher and higher until he was willing to pay nine times
the price of the flour as profit.
